proposed_widenings.name: modify_size
proposed_widenings.justification: Large Form's core transformation changes the creature's size category for a timed duration. The current surface has no effect atom for temporary size-category changes outside full polymorph/stat-block replacement.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action"

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.abilityFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: The current roll-advantage atom can narrow ability checks by skill, but not by raw ability. Large Form grants Advantage on all Strength checks, not just Athletics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks"

proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord.characterLevelGate
proposed_widenings.justification: This species trait is unavailable until character level 5. SpeciesTraitRecord has no field to encode a level-gated trait.

proposed_widenings.name: Duration.manualEndNoAction
proposed_widenings.justification: The transformation has a timed duration but can also be ended early by the bearer without spending an action. Current Duration shapes do not encode that early self-dismiss path for activated non-spell traits.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required)"

notes: Did not author content/species_goliath_large_form.dhall because any valid record would omit core mechanics. The family fit is otherwise species_trait + activation: bonus action, use_count 1, long-rest reset, timed self-buff, modify_speed +10.
